about_the_game:
Marianne Avalone just inherited her parent's adventuring business, but there's a small problem... she's not suited to adventuring!

It's time to sort through all of the party member applications, hire the best-of-the-best, and assign them to profitable quests. Marianne needs to quickly earn tons of gold if she wants to cancel her engagement to Duke Douglas Nightgrave's son!

Sort Through Documents

Your desk fills up with more-and-more documents with every passing day. It seems impossible to get it all processed before the day's end.

Dispose of old reports, keep useful documents in storage, and stack similar pages on your desk so that you can keep organized as you process all of your paper-work.

Hire Applicants

Avalone's Adventurers won't be able to function without a party of skilled adventurers!

Hire plenty of people from all walks of life that meet your cost and skill requirements.

Accept Quests

An adventuring party wouldn't be a business if it didn't take on quests.

With a deadline looming it'll be necessary to take on the boldest quests available to earn maximum profits, or at the very least enough gold to pay your party members!

Hoard Gold

Marianne will need a huge pile of gold to cancel her engagement with Duke Douglas Nightgrave's son.

Can she stack enough gold coins on her table to embarrass a dragon before it's too late!?

Cancel the Engagement

Marianne never knew why her parents arranged for her engagement to Duke Nightgrave's son when they knew that she never liked the duke and never mind his son! But the duke has the forms signed by her parents, and he demands to be reimbursed for the prepaid wedding expenses if the engagement is to be cancelled.

  • Processor: Intel Pentium Gold 4415Y 1.6GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.2GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
